role: Core of the shared morning-summary narrative generator (used by MorningResultsViewModel, PDFReportGenerator+Summary and the assistant ContextBuilder): output/input models, init (filters recent sessions to strictly earlier nights), generate(), and the overnight trend-statistics computation (averages, 5-night baselines, 7-day trend).
types: AnalysisSummaryGenerator: class — builds AnalysisSummary from one HRVAnalysisResult + context; extended by +Interpretation and +Steps
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.ProbableCause: struct — cause, raw English confidence key, explanation
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.TrendStats: struct — period averages/baselines/7-day trend; static empty
state: mem:AnalysisSummaryGenerator.stats (lazy var TrendStats, computed once per instance via computeTrendStats(referenceDate:))
mem:AnalysisSummaryGenerator.diagnosticScore (lazy var Double, computeDiagnosticScore() run once per instance; read by generate() and headlineScore)
toplevel: Stored lets hold all inputs; `lazy var stats` (line 107) runs computeTrendStats(referenceDate: referenceDate) on first access and caches it (the class is not Sendable/locked; each caller builds its own instance). `lazy var diagnosticScore` caches computeDiagnosticScore() the same way, so the summary field, the headline fallback and the headline-driven title/icon/steps compute it once. The referenceDate doc comment says what it does: it is capped at the session's end and only reaches the output through the unreachable daySpan fallback. File-scope private functions sessionBaselines and average live after the class. The TrendStats fields daySpan and trend30Day are written here but read by no production code (only EmuquTests/CauseDetectorTests.swift:41,43 construct them); trend30Day is always nil (line 200).

units.does: Returns the ProbableCause confidence in NarrativeLanguage by mapping the raw English key back to DetectedCause.CauseConfidence and reading its label; falls back to the raw key.

branches.cond: confidence string parses as a CauseConfidence rawValue ('?? confidence')
branches.effect: parsed → localized label; unparseable → raw English key string shown as-is

units.does: Stores all inputs; filters recentSessions to sessions that start strictly before this session and are not this session; clamps referenceDate to no later than max(session.startDate, session.endDate ?? startDate).

branches.effect: nil end → startDate used as the session end for the referenceDate clamp; else endDate

units.does: Builds AnalysisSummary by evaluating analysisTitle, diagnosticIcon, the lazily cached diagnosticScore, headlineScore, analysisExplanation, probableCauses, keyFindings, actionableSteps and trendInsight.
Filters recentSessions to complete overnight sessions with an analysisResult that are reliable for HRV aggregates; returns TrendStats.empty when fewer than 2, else trendStats(for:referenceDate:).

branches.effect: return TrendStats.empty (hasData false → all trend findings/insights suppressed); else compute stats

units.does: Computes SessionAverages, returns empty when the RMSSD average is not positive; else builds TrendStats with averages, 5-night baselines, session count, day span between first and last session, trend7Day from TrendVerdict.weeklyRMSSDChange, trend30Day nil.

branches.effect: unreachable: validSessions has >= 2 entries so min/max are non-nil; referenceDate is never used
day nil → daySpan 0; otherwise the day difference

units.does: Computes period averages: RMSSD = canonicalBaselineRMSSD if passed else geometric mean of session RMSSDs; HR = canonicalBaselineHR if passed else arithmetic mean (0 if none); stress and readiness = arithmetic means or nil when none.

branches.effect: nil → geometricMean(rmssdValues); else the canonical score baseline (so the 'recent average' text quotes the score baseline, not these sessions)
canonical present → used; else empty → 0, non-empty → arithmetic mean

units.does: Geometric mean of the positive values; returns the arithmetic mean (0 for empty) when no value is positive.

branches.effect: return arithmetic fallback; else exp(mean(ln v)) over positives only (non-positive values silently dropped)

units.does: File-scope: picks sessions carrying the system Morning tag, matched by ReadingTag.morning.id (falls back to all valid sessions when none), requires >= 3, then averages RMSSD, mean HR and stress index of the 5 most recent.

branches.cond: no session carries the system Morning tag (id match)
branches.effect: use all valid sessions; else only Morning-tagged ones
return (nil,nil,nil); else averages of the 5 newest

units.does: File-scope: arithmetic mean of values, nil for empty.
